posts.title: Taskfile project introduction
posts.description: I spend a lot of time on my https://taskfile.build/ project. What started as a standard to run any git project with bash, has become a command library for a wide range of software tools. Every git project I am working with has a task script (aka Taskfile) in its root. The Taskfile provides all functions to run the project. posts.title: The least thing you can do about ai
posts.description: I am still writing the ai call lower case and call agents “clankers”. Because writing “AI” is too bold and calling clankers “agents” assumes some degree of agency. And this is simply not true. As it always was with Open Source Software (OSS) my only request to the world is to choose alternatives over proprietary. And with ai we have entered another level of proprietary dependencies and vendor-lock
